profile.headline: Software Engineer Technical Leader at Cisco Meraki
profile.summary: Software engineering technical leader in AI product; AI enthusiast with experience in LLM, Embedding, VectorDB and agentic architecture (LangChain / LangGraph);  Full-stack engineer with both web and mobile front (React Native);

positions.title: Software Engineer Technical Lead
positions.description:
● Onboarded teams and individual engineers into AI projects
● Helped integrating multiple AI products across multiple business units
● Developed / maintain a multi-agent AI product using LangGraph
● Developed / maintain an AI tool search component using vector DB and its release strategy
● Researched AI techniques and architectures, including prompt engineering, embedding, agent and MCP
● Participated in the team planning, quality review, and technical design

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Developed a multi-agent AI product using LangGraph
● Developed an AI tool search component using vector DB and its release strategy
● Researched AI techniques and architectures, including prompt engineering, embedding, agent and MCP
● Participated in the team planning, quality review, and technical design
● Created AWS CDN solution for web app as well as CI pipeline for deployment
● Designed micro services to access large scale data
● Developed / maintained React Native mobile app, web app, and native widgets
● Developed / maintained RAILS based back-end codes
● Designed / developed multiple features for users to manage their network / hardwares / clients

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
● Developed / maintained AngularJS and ReactJS based front-end codes
● Developed / maintained RAILS based back-end codes
● Designed / developed multiple features for users to manage their retirement plan using ReactJS, AngularJS, and RAILS
● Built integration test framework / tests for the full-stack features 
● Contributed in the development of a project through the software lifecycle, from requirements definition through successful deployment

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
● Learned new technologies, Ember.js, RSpec, Ruby on Rails, Ruby gem
● Developed internal tools (ruby gem) for core engineers
● Trained for Agile software development and participated in scrum framework

positions.title: Programming Intern
positions.description:
● Maintained and improved the back-end system, which increased understanding of database
● Developed new tools to assist data transfer from raw data to database
● Assisted developing front-end interface and connecting with back-end tools

positions.title: Software QA Test
positions.description:
● Conducted manual/automated tests on the client web sites 
● Developed automated tests using PHP and Javascript according to manual tests

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
● Experienced real life software development, and applied software engineering principles
● Learned new script language(ruby) and used it to create test script for the APIs
● Cooperated the team projects from various departments
● Assisted the technical communication in other language (translation and interpretation Korean, Japanese)

positions.title: Linux Lab assistant
positions.description:
● Helped about 10 students a week to understand the principles of the programming
● Encouraged students to solve the assigned programming assignments
● Demonstrated skills while teaching students, which increased experience with programming

positions.title: Web developer
positions.description:
● Applied web development skills with assigned design from the director (15 pages) 
● Developed and designed web pages for clients from other department (8 pages) 
● Utilized web page functionalities using CSS, Javascript, and JQuery (6 pages)

projects.title: Turret project
projects.description: The senior project focused on image processing. It finds an object using color and shape.

projects.title: Desk Clock application for Android
projects.description: A small desk clock application for android smart phone. It was for myself to explore the android application development.
